name: bytes
js: (() => { const e = performance.getEntriesByType("resource"); let t = 0, b = 0, d = 0; for (const x of e) { t += x.transferSize || 0; b += x.encodedBodySize || 0; d += x.decodedBodySize || 0; } return { requests: e.length, transferSize: t, encodedBodySize: b, decodedBodySize: d, names: e.map((x) => x.name.replace(location.origin, "").split("?")[0]).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i).sort() }; })()
